events.title: Ferdinand Magellan is killed on Mactan
events.description: Magellan died fighting the forces of the chief Lapulapu in the Philippines. Under Juan Sebastián Elcano, one ship of his fleet returned to Spain in 1522, completing the first circumnavigation.
events.html: Magellan died fighting the forces of the chief Lapulapu in the Philippines. Under Juan Sebastián Elcano, one ship of his fleet returned to Spain in 1522, completing the first circumnavigation.

events.title: Montrose's royalists are routed at Carbisdale
events.description: The Marquess of Montrose, landing in Scotland for the exiled Charles II, was defeated by Covenanter forces. He was captured and hanged in Edinburgh a month later.
events.html: The Marquess of Montrose, landing in Scotland for the exiled Charles II, was defeated by Covenanter forces. He was captured and hanged in Edinburgh a month later.

events.title: Samuel Morse is born in Massachusetts
events.description: Samuel Morse, painter turned inventor, was born in Charlestown. He developed an electric telegraph and, with Alfred Vail, the code that bears his name.
events.html: Samuel Morse, painter turned inventor, was born in Charlestown. He developed an electric telegraph and, with Alfred Vail, the code that bears his name.

events.title: Beethoven dates the manuscript of Für Elise
events.description: Beethoven's autograph of the Bagatelle in A minor carried the date 27 April 1810. Unpublished in his lifetime, it appeared in 1867 and became one of the best-known piano pieces.
events.html: Beethoven's autograph of the Bagatelle in A minor carried the date 27 April 1810. Unpublished in his lifetime, it appeared in 1867 and became one of the best-known piano pieces.

events.title: Partisans capture Mussolini at Dongo
events.description: Disguised in a German greatcoat in a convoy heading north, Benito Mussolini was recognised and seized by Italian partisans near Lake Como. He was shot the next day.
events.html: Disguised in a German greatcoat in a convoy heading north, Benito Mussolini was recognised and seized by Italian partisans near Lake Como. He was shot the next day.

events.title: South Africa holds its first all-race elections
events.description: Millions of Black South Africans voted for the first time. The ANC won decisively and Nelson Mandela became president, ending the apartheid order. The date is now Freedom Day.
events.html: Millions of Black South Africans voted for the first time. The ANC won decisively and Nelson Mandela became president, ending the apartheid order. The date is now Freedom Day.
